video_title: Doug Christie addresses Kings' 'low' energy after loss to Spurs | NBC Sports California

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: Doug Christie on the Kings' low energy and lack of discipline
quotes.excerpt: I thought the energy just was low. I talked to them about discipline and consistency.
quotes.quote: I thought the energy just was low. You know, bottling up that energy that we had to get to that is I talked to them about discipline and consistency. And you know, a hot guy, you can't go under. You go under, he hits a shot, he sees it go in and all of a sudden, he's in fuego. You got to make sure that you step up, that you turn his water off immediately. But, you know, a disciplined team, they're going to continue on running their stuff.
quotes.social_post: Doug Christie says the Kings lacked discipline and energy against the Spurs, noting that when a shooter gets hot, you have to step up and turn his water off immediately.

structured.context: Doug Christie discusses the Sacramento Kings' lack of energy and discipline following a loss to the San Antonio Spurs.

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: Doug Christie emphasizes the need for a gang rebounding mentality
quotes.excerpt: It has to be a gang rebound mentality. Everyone has to come back and help out.
quotes.quote: The offensive rebounds, this is the second game that we've given up 20 offensive rebounds. And it has to be a gang rebound mentality. Everyone has to come back and help out on the backboard. And that doesn't mean turning and looking, and I'm sure when I go back and watch this, I'm going to see a lot of that. And it's you got to check your guy first, hit him, and then pursue the basketball.
quotes.social_post: Doug Christie is calling for a gang rebound mentality after the Kings gave up 20 offensive rebounds for the second straight game.

structured.context: Doug Christie addresses the team's struggles with defensive rebounding and the need for a collective effort on the boards.

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: Doug Christie explains the importance of checking your man on rebounds
quotes.excerpt: When the shot goes up, you have to check your man. That's what you have to do.
quotes.quote: It's a focus thing because when the shot goes up, you have to check your man. That's what you have to do. And I'm pretty sure when I go back, I'm going to see a lot of guys just looking and then they're just running right at the rim. That is just attention to detail. Is there a little energy in that? Yeah, there is, because you got to stay locked in and make sure that you're checking your guy off.
quotes.social_post: Doug Christie says the Kings' rebounding struggles come down to a lack of attention to detail, noting that players are watching the ball instead of checking their man.

structured.context: Doug Christie explains that the team's rebounding issues stem from a lack of attention to detail regarding boxing out opponents.

quotes.speaker: Doug Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: Doug Christie addresses De'Aaron Fox's performance and health status
quotes.excerpt: He was a little under the weather. But he's a competitor, I'm not worried about him.
quotes.quote: He was a little under the weather. But you know, I mean, he probably wouldn't say that, but he was. Just a fact and tried to work him through it. I thought his energy got better as the game went on. But yeah, I mean, first time back-to-back, first time three in four nights, but he's a competitor, I'm not worried about him. But you know, the health part of it, sometimes you're feeling it, sometimes you're not.
quotes.social_post: Doug Christie reveals De'Aaron Fox was playing while under the weather during the Kings' recent stretch of games.

structured.context: Doug Christie reveals that De'Aaron Fox was playing while feeling under the weather during the game.
